procedures.trigger: A material system change crosses component/service/data/deployment boundaries.
steps: Capture current accepted architecture and stakeholder concerns.
State required quality attributes as scenarios or constraints.
Map affected boundaries, dependencies, failure domains, and data ownership.
Generate viable options including no-change where applicable.
Compare consequences, reversibility, migration, observability, and specialist handoffs.
Write/propose ADR and define architecture-level evidence needed before acceptance.
stop_conditions: A material constraint is unknown and would make option comparison fictional.
Security/privacy/data/operations acceptance would have to be invented.
No rollback or migration path exists for a change that requires one.

procedures.trigger: A system needs an architecture description or recovery of implicit structure.
steps: Map current entities, interfaces, data/state ownership, execution/deployment boundaries.
Select views/model kinds that expose important concerns.
Record invariants, quality attributes, known risks, and unresolved architecture debt.
Establish ADR/history linkage and verification hooks.
stop_conditions: Observed system cannot be distinguished from planned architecture.
Critical topology or data ownership is unavailable and cannot be bounded.
